concept: Rebuilding after a major life disruption (health, relationship, relocation) with a realistic, staged plan
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic major life disruption where the adult needs to rebuild routines, relationships, or stability from a genuinely difficult starting point
exercise.reflection_prompt: What would a realistic first stage of rebuilding look like — not the whole solution, just the next stage?
exercise.practice: Adult outlines one concrete, achievable first stage rather than the entire rebuilding process at once

assessment.success_marker: adult's proposed first stage is genuinely achievable in the near term, not an overwhelming full solution
